cafeLan.title: Local waiter connection
cafeLan.internetRequired: The main terminal needs Internet to commit orders, payments and table changes. A failed connection keeps the original action pending.
cafeLan.desktopMainOnly: This desktop can receive waiter requests when configured as a main terminal. Import the code on an Android waiter.
cafeLan.noChildren: No linked waiter terminals are available.
cafeLan.codeHelp: Share this code only with the selected waiter. It hides after five minutes.
cafeLan.failed: Could not complete the connection action. Check Internet, terminal configuration and the LAN address, then retry.
cafeLan.rotationHelp: Generating or revoking a code replaces the existing pairing and clears encrypted pending replies. The waiter must import the new code; original queued actions remain pending. Continue?
cafeLan.unavailable: LAN service is not ready on this device.
